# DriveMy

DriveMy is a bilingual (English and Bahasa Malaysia) study companion for Malaysian learner drivers preparing for the JPJ KPP1 theory exam. It offers theory notes, quizzes, full mock exams, a road signs directory and a 3D driving simulator. It is an unofficial study aid and is not affiliated with JPJ.

Sign-in is with Google. Learner results are private to the signed-in account.
